notes: Recheck of 20 Penn clubs that the directory marked INACTIVE. Six have dated activity in the last 12 months and are full records: Petey Greene (program site posts dated 2026, newest 2026/10/7), UMOJA (probably_active, funding total for the 2025 to 2026 academic year), VITA @ Penn (Fall 2026 application due September 18, 2026), West Philadelphia Sanctuary (probably_active, a 2026 award with no month), Wharton Energy Conference (conference on October 30, 2026), and Wellness Student Coalition (Wellness Week 2026 page). Fourteen are held back as unknown: Accountability Initiative, Italian Club, UL Journal, UMC, Upstream, WasteWise, We Can Swim, WASA, WACC, Wharton Crew Team, WAAG, Wharton Graduate Association (newest dated item 2021, so possibly dormant), Wharton Muslims in Business (site unreadable on two tries), and Wharton Retail Club. Several held-back clubs have working sites with no dates (We Can Swim, WAAG, UMC, UL Journal, Retail Club). The status rules would call those probably_active, but the batch rule holds them back, so the orchestrator may want to decide. Where a page gives only a year, no last_sign_of_life month is written. Named but not checked: Campaign for Working Families (cwfphilly.org), the partner in the VITA description. Instagram, Facebook, Eventbrite, and Google Form links were not opened. The Wellness site redirected from upennwellness.com to upennwellness.wordpress.com and that redirect was followed. Searches used: 0. Fetches used: about 37.
